# Prompt Hub — AI Image Prompt Library

> A free, copy-ready library of AI image-generation prompts, organised into 16 categories. Browse, copy, paste into your image model.

## What this site is

Prompt Hub (imgprompt.craftisle.com) collects image-generation prompts written for GPT Image and comparable text-to-image models. Each prompt has its own page with the full text and a preview image; prompts are grouped into categories, and a search page covers the whole library.

Scope note: this is a prompt library, not an image generator. Images shown on a prompt page are examples of what the prompt produces, not a hosted generation service.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/): entry point with featured prompts
- [Categories](https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/category): all 16 categories
- [Search](https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/search): full-library search
- [Templates](https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/template): reusable prompt templates
- Sitemap: https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml

## URL pattern

- `https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/prompt/{slug}` — one page per prompt (full prompt text)
- `https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/category/{slug}` — category listing

## Citing

`Prompt Hub, https://imgprompt.craftisle.com/`
